record.field: Skapa en security.alert i Odoo från ett Zabbix-larm. Severity mappas automatiskt: info→info, warning→low, average→medium, high→high, disaster→critical. Idempotent via source_ref.

async def execute(name, severity='info', description='', source_ref='', host=None, trigger_id=None): """Skapa security.alert (idempotent).""" return env['ai.coworker'].zabbix_create_alert( name=str(name), severity=str(severity), description=str(description), source_ref=str(source_ref), host=host, trigger_id=trigger_id)
Tar emot Zabbix-larm via webhook och skapar security.alert
